title: Shenzhen PDF Reader — Free, open-source reader for Mac
description: Free, open-source document reader for Mac. Read PDFs and Markdown, search documents, organize tabs and keep local backups. Optional AI with source links.
lede: A free, open-source document reader for Mac. Search your files, organize them in groups, and keep local backups. Reading needs no account. AI is optional and uses your own OpenRouter credits.
requirements: Apple Silicon · macOS 12 or later · Signed & notarized
screenshot_alt: Two documents compared in chat, with source citations and a 24-month answer card beside the source PDF
caption: Compare two plans and check the source behind the answer. Scripted example using fictional documents.
feature1: Ask questions across documents and follow links back to the source. Generate summaries, tags and missing chapters. Chats are saved locally.
feature2: Render diagrams, equations, tables and highlighted code. Set paper size, margins and page breaks. Export to PDF.
feature3: Type to search the current document. See each match in context. Use ⌘K to find an open document or a saved copy.
workspace: Drag related documents into groups. The app remembers your tabs and reading position. Collection keeps local copies and earlier versions; you choose how much disk space it can use.
groups_alt: Shenzhen PDF Reader with colored document groups and a compact sidebar
formats_description: PDF, EPUB, Markdown, plain text, supported source languages and images. HTML opens as source. Local OCR creates searchable PDFs; offline translation uses Argos Translate.
a1: The reader is free and open source. Reading, local history, OCR and translation do not require an account. Optional AI uses your OpenRouter account and paid credits.
a2: Reading, Collection, OCR and translation run locally. Optional AI sends retrieved document content to OpenRouter and its provider; chat and automatic analysis can be disabled separately. Credentials stay in macOS Keychain. Linked document images and update checks can use the network.
a3: The download above is the signed, notarized macOS app for Apple Silicon. A GTK4 Linux frontend is also available in the project. The Windows frontend is in development and has no published binary.
q4: Can an AI agent control the reader?
a4: Use the local CLI/MCP interface to inspect documents, organize groups and set Markdown layout. In-app chat can also perform supported reader actions, with Undo/Redo.
download_info: Latest stable macOS release, signed and notarized. Updates are built in.
footer: Shenzhen PDF Reader is also known as ShenzhenPDF. Inspired by SumatraPDF; a separate project, not affiliated with it. This website uses no analytics or third-party fonts.
markdown_text: Edit in your preferred editor; the reader reloads changes automatically. Export the same layout to PDF.
markdown_alt: Native Markdown document with a vector diagram and table, including macOS window controls
search_text: See the matching text, its chapter and its position in the document. Click a result to go there.
search_alt: PDF search results with contextual matches, page highlights and document map, including macOS window controls
ai_notice: AI uses paid OpenRouter credits and sends retrieved content to the model provider. Check the sources: models make mistakes.
